messages.text: Keep this objective active: {goal}. The current state is {state}. What remains?
I’ll track the objective as {goal}. Current state: {state}. Remaining work: {remaining}.
I’m pausing here. Continue from the current state later.
Saved summary: objective is {goal}; current state is {state}; next step is {remaining}.
Plan {task}. Keep each session under {limit} minutes and do not schedule one before {time}.
I’ll plan {task} with sessions under {limit} minutes, all starting at or after {time}.
Add a break between sessions without changing those limits.
I’ll keep the same duration and start-time limits and place a break between the sessions.
Which {item} was selected? The note says only {known}.
The note establishes {known}, but it does not identify the {item}. I can’t determine that from the information provided.
Can you infer it from the note?
No. The note does not contain the selected {item}, so I should leave it unspecified.
The working note says {old}.
I’ll use {old} as the current value.
Correction: the approved record says {new}.
I’ll replace {old} with {new} and use the approved record as the current source.
What value are you tracking now?
The current value is {new}. The earlier value, {old}, has been superseded.
Source A says {first}. Source B says {second}. What is confirmed by both?
Those statements do not establish the same result. I need matching evidence or item-level detail before I can say what both sources confirm.
The records share {overlap}.
Then {overlap} is confirmed by both records. The remaining details are not established by their overlap.
Keep this state: objective {goal}; completed {done}; open {open}; next action {next}.
I have recorded the objective and current state.
Summarize it for later continuation.
Objective: {goal}. Completed: {done}. Open: {open}. Next: {next}.
I’m back. What is the next action?
Continue with {next}. The open work is {open}; completed work is {done}.
